purpose: Measure source discrepancy to reconcile documented published benchmark size with hash-pinned archive; not to tune a scientific procedure.
methods: Second full read-only scan of TRAIN member only, compute raw byte SHA256, exact full row count, distinct PID count; no object lookup/latent truth or learning, no heldout/valid/test reads. Parse Q/P/Q shape to fail closed on invalid statements; cap 30 million rows and 600 s scan.
decision: If full row count equals published count => matched. Otherwise preserve SOURCE_PUBLISHED_COUNT_MISMATCH and do NOT call this data standard published benchmark. May use separately described historical source for future independent prereg but never doctor performance.
authority: Read-only provenance check; original WSP101 cohorts and valid/test untouched, no scientific first-use, model write, merge, controller, scheduler or paid API.
